entries.content_plain: PSALM 28 Psa 28:1-9 . An earnest cry for divine aid against his enemies, as being also those of God, is followed by the Psalmist's praise in assurance of a favorable answer, and a prayer for all God's people. 1. my rock-- ( Psa 18:2 , 31 ). be not silent to me-- literally, "from me," deaf or inattentive. become like them, &c.-- share their fate. go down into the pit-- or, "grave" ( Psa 30:3 ).
